source.note: Wave-1 row 187 named a Quaternius static model on poly.pizza (Cloudflare challenge, off limits); Quaternius Ultimate Food Pack (OpenGameArt) has no ramen and Kenney Food Kit only a generic hexagonal broth bowl. This is a CC0 ramen bowl on OpenGameArt with modelled chopsticks, half egg, bok choy, chashu and a few noodle strands; its texture was painted from a CC0 Wikimedia Commons photo (Daderot, Chicken ramen - London, UK) and is flattened to flat colours. The duplicate bowl and loose chopsticks in the .blend are dropped.
